company.name: Synapse Analytics
company.shortDescription: AI risk platform for lenders to automate the entire credit lifecycle—enabling faster, smarter, and more inclusive credit decisions.
company.description:
We help financial institutions make better risk decisions with AI.

Synapse Analytics enables them to automate the entire credit lifecycle—from onboarding and verification to assessment and decisioning.

Our AI-powered infrastructure brings speed, accuracy, and intelligence to every step of the credit process. Whether you're serving first-time borrowers or scaling complex lending operations, we help you move faster, reduce risk, and unlock financial access for more customers. With built-in orchestration capabilities, you can centralize fragmented workflows, enforce policies, and coordinate teams—seamlessly and at scale.

Our tools are built for business and risk teams—not technical experts. No-code, intuitive, and ready to use out of the box. Just better decisions, faster.

By simplifying complex processes and reducing barriers, Synapse Analytics plays a key role in expanding financial inclusion—empowering more people and businesses to access the credit they need to grow.
